SELECT i_item_id, AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS cd_filtered ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd_filtered.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AS promo_filtered ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promo_filtered.p_promo_sk 
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS date_filtered ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk 
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
WHERE 1=1 
GROUP BY i_item_id 
ORDER BY i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
